Subject: Security intake and pen test handback timeline — next steps

Hi Mitchell — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed action items from our discovery call: 

- Scope we discussed: Greenline Health will evaluate Redwood for patient-facing document summarization and internal reporting pipelines (PII/PHI in scope).
- Compliance signals requested: SOC 2 Type II status, GDPR/Data processing agreements, HIPAA readiness remarks, and any recent pen test artifacts.
- Ask: please initiate the vendor security questionnaire (link below) and share the most recent pen test report (redacted is fine) plus an asset inventory for the systems that will interact with Redwood.

Our suggested next steps / timeline: 
1) Greenline confirms SOC 2 status and provides asset inventory (by 2026-09-10).
2) We exchange vendor questionnaire and begin intake (DocuSign link included).
3) If pen test report exists, share a redacted copy; otherwise confirm planned pen test window and expected handback — target report delivery to align with procurement timeline (we'd prefer a preliminary summary within 2 weeks and full report no later than 2026-09-24).

Operational expectations we use for procurement / security sign-off (high level):
- Remediation SLAs: critical within 72 hours, high within 14 days, medium 30 days, low 90 days.
- Scanning cadence: infra monthly, app quarterly, with verified reconfirmation before production cutover.
- Vulnerability disclosure: we follow a 90-day responsible disclosure window unless otherwise negotiated.

I'm attaching a short vendor questionnaire and an asset inventory template to make this easier. Marissa (security) and Karthik (SE) are on the thread to help with any technical clarifications. Can you confirm the POC on your side and whether the dates above are realistic?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the procurement timeline moving.

--

Hi Mitchell — thanks for confirming POC. Adding a bit more color on Redwood's security intake expectations so you can pass to your security team: 

1) Pen test expectations (minimum):
   - External network perimeter + public API testing (unauthenticated and authenticated flows).
   - Authenticated application testing covering any user-role privilege escalation scenarios that can touch PHI.
   - OWASP Top 10 coverage and API-specific test cases.

2) Remediation SLAs (definitions):
   - Critical: vulnerability leading to immediate data exposure or remote code execution; we expect acknowledgement within 4 hours and remediation/workaround within 72 hours.
   - High: privilege escalation, broken auth, sensitive data exposure — patch/mitigation within 14 days.
   - Medium: integrity or information leaks with limited impact — patch within 30 days.
   - Low: informational or best-practice items — tracked and closed within 90 days.

3) Scanning cadence and maintenance:
   - Infrastructure (host/infra) automated scans: monthly.
   - Application / API dynamic scans: quarterly and after significant releases.
   - Continuous vuln monitoring and prioritized triage meetings during onboarding window.

4) Vulnerability disclosure: 90-day standard opt-in disclosure policy; exceptions negotiable if both parties agree.

Attached: redwood-penreport-example-redacted.pdf (example redacted report) and a short remediation plan template. Also linking the DocuSign questionnaire if you'd prefer to sign and return.

If Greenline can provide the asset inventory (use our template) and a timeline for the next pen test (if internal one is insufficient), we can map that against procurement/engineering dependencies. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up with your security lead next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
